overview: Host Terry Carter interviewed Medford resident Stephen 'Smitty' Smith about his social justice brand and book, 'The Elephant in the Room,' followed by a series of poetry and jazz performances by Carter and The Ally Project.

items.title: Interview with Stephen Smitty Smith
items.summary: Stephen 'Smitty' Smith shared his background growing up in New York and Boston, detailing how his early experiences shaped his life in Massachusetts.

items.title: The Elephant in the Room Business and Book
items.summary: Smith explained how the COVID-19 pandemic and racial violence inspired him to launch his clothing brand and co-author the collaborative book, 'The Elephant in the Room: A Prison with No Bars.'

items.title: Career Reflections, Word Association, and Advice
items.summary: Smith discussed his proudest family accomplishments, shared stories of his early connection to the hip-hop artist Guru, and participated in a brief word-association game about social issues.

items.title: Introduction of The Ally Project
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced The Ally Project, a jazz and poetry collaboration with musician Jonathan Fagan celebrating Poetry Month.

items.title: West Medford Historical Poetry Readings
items.summary: Carter performed historical poetry pieces about West Medford, highlighting segregation, neighborhood history, and the gentrification of local landmarks.

items.title: Social Justice Poetry and Jazz Performances
items.summary: Carter and the band performed several musical-poetic pieces addressing family legacy, xenophobia, border walls, and the complexities of racial allyship.

items.title: Community Announcements and Adjournment
items.summary: Carter concluded the meeting by thanking sponsors, promoting the community center's senior and after-school programs, and inviting attendees to purchase Smith's merchandise.
